item.title: How I Take My Notes
item.description: As an engineering student, I’ve spent the last six years refining how I take notes. I’ve tested countless systems, fallen into productivity rabbit holes, and ultimately landed on a simple, effective philosophy. In this post, I' ll go through the principles I apply when taking notes. Writing for Understanding Writing is one of the best ways to solidify understanding. As Prof. Feynman teaches, explaining something in your own words forces you to think more deeply and identify gaps in your knowledge.

item.title: Tmux Setup
item.description: How I use tmux Tmux is a terminal multiplexer: it lets you open multiple panes, windows, and sessions seamlessly. I started using it for a neatly organized terminal setup and am perfecting its use while trying to solve CTF challenges. Being efficient in moving from one terminal window to the other is essential for ease of mind. Additionally, exploiting tmux splitting panes functions with pwntools script, I think, can give you a competitive edge when debugging exploits.

item.title: H4cked writeup
item.description: H4cked - TryHackMe Room walkthrough H4cked is a beginner room from TryHackMe. We’ll have to apply offensive and defensive concepts to complete the room. Oh no! We’ve been hacked! item.title: About me
item.description: Hi! I am Alessandro Lo Prete. I am a researcher and engineer passionate about solving complex problems with real-world impact. I have worked with the European Space Agency, first as an intern and currently for my Master’s thesis, strengthening my research and development capabilities in cutting-edge projects. My technical interests span malware analysis, compilers, and threat intelligence. I thrive in both independent and collaborative environments, bringing leadership experience and a self-driven mindset.
